general.name: Connection Health - Ping Targets Not Responding [Lin]
general.description: Alerts when ping targets stop replying or WireGuard peers stop handshaking, e.g. across a site-to-site tunnel. Read-only. Bad input or a failed check also alerts. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrTargets
variables.description: 1-8 IPs or hostnames to ping, space or comma separated. Use hosts that are always on (e.g. the far gateway LAN IP). Empty: WireGuard checks only.

variables.name: usrRequire
variables.description: Any: alert only when no target replies / no peer is current. All: alert when any target or peer fails.

variables.name: usrReplyTimeoutSec
variables.description: 1-5. Seconds to wait for each reply.

variables.name: usrSource
variables.description: Optional. Interface (wg0) or local IP to ping from. Needed on a tunnel gateway whose tunnel only carries LAN-sourced traffic.

variables.name: usrWgInterface
variables.description: Optional. WireGuard interface (wg0) to check: up, and peers handshaked recently. Empty: ping checks only.

variables.name: usrHandshakeMaxAgeSec
variables.description: 150-3600. A peer whose last handshake is older than this counts as stale.
